privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tethered shooting by cable: read photos newly taken on a camera connected with a USB cable.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tethered shooting: receive photos your camera sends over your local network using its FTP auto-transfer.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save your retouched photos to your photo library.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose photos from your library to retouch.

versions.localizedDescription: Tonewell 0.3.7: changing the retouch level on photos of large groups no longer slows down (on a Mac about 1.6-2.1 s each time), and drags start sooner after a retouching control. Finished pictures are identical to 0.3.6.

Tonewell 0.3.6: drags on photos of large groups are quick again (on a 29-face photo the first frame takes about 0.1-0.2 s, as in 0.3.4, instead of 0.9-1 s in 0.3.5). Finished pictures are identical to 0.3.5.

Tonewell 0.3.5: smoother drags right after opening a photo or letting go of a slider; on a 60 MP photo a drag in the first second no longer stops once for about 0.15 s. Finished pictures are identical to 0.3.4.
Tonewell 0.3.4: sliders show their first frame sooner when you start dragging (skin Strength on a 60 MP photo about 0.11 s → 0.05 s); finished pictures are identical to 0.3.3.

Tonewell 0.3.3: on faces seen from the side or cut off by the edge of the picture, the eye is no longer smeared into a grey band and the lips are no longer treated as a blemish; frontal faces are not affected.
Tonewell 0.3.2: sliders show the picture live again with Noise reduction on; Remove spots no longer leaves pale, flat patches on large areas of acne, and dark spots no longer turn pink.

Tonewell 0.3.1: pictures appear sooner, no pause the first time a slider is used, JPEG/HEIC face areas no longer one row off, and models downloaded for an earlier version are no longer used after an update.
Tonewell 0.3: fine control over face and body, settings for each person, photo selection, 20 languages, much faster sliders; optional age model download.
